title: Include leakage replacement in an explicit four-spin control contract
statement: The explicit encoder maps one logical qubit into the four-spin singlet code using nine two-level Givens operations compiled to 25 addressed primitives, 500 CNOTs and 1032 one-qubit gates with one restored clean work qubit. U-dagger plus discarding is a CPTP inverse on the code but differs on leakage from the required canonical reset completion; the syndrome measurement and replacement must actually be implemented.
